PaymentService/Authorize.no3ds_auto_capture_google_pay_encrypted: The scenario's token is replaced by a browser-generated Google Pay token, which needs GPAY_HOSTED_URL and a metadata.google_pay gateway block for shift4 in creds.json; the shift4 creds carry neither, so the scenario can only skip. Shift4 accepts only a Google Pay token issued for its own gateway and, for PAN_ONLY credentials, declines with HTTP 402 authentication_required without browser 3DS. Google Pay CRYPTOGRAM_3DS Authorize, SetupRecurring and RecurringPaymentService/Charge were verified against the Shift4 sandbox by grpcurl instead (PR #2279).
